_how_it_is_used: server_scripts/grindless/uxv/cygnus_disk.js makes one recipe per entry, id grindless:<type>/<name>, with its programmed circuit; 'site' true locks the recipe to grindless:cygnus_x1_orbit; 'wear' inputs are consumed by their chance (out of 10000); 'generator' true writes the EUt negative (a generator type). disk_skimming, frc_forming and blandford_znajek are package UXV-B3's machine types (data key = dataKey, the EMI line). Package UXV-B3, docs/eras/uxv.md machines 13-15 and process lines 30-31.

recipes._why: machine 13 c1: a magnetic scoop in the outer disk takes 1,000 mB of the disk's own plasma; the scoop's metallic hydrogen winding wears 5% a run
recipes.name: skim_disk

recipes._why: machine 14 c1: a theta-pinch on four MH windings traps a field-reversed plasmoid in a cartridge; the windings wear 10% a run. Filtered disk plasma is B2's, made from B3's disk plasma
recipes.name: form_cartridge

recipes._why: machine 14 c2: the same pinch without a cartridge loads the plasma with flux for the BZ dynamo; the plasma lost in formation recombines to hydrogen, which goes to stock
recipes.name: load_flux

recipes._why: machine 15 c1: field lines threading the horizon carry the spin's power out through the jet; 400 mB of flux-loaded plasma (one FRC c2 batch, 2 mB/t) feeds 200 t at 2^30 EU/t. The chain (disk 556 mB, filter c2, FRC c2) costs about 1.3e11 EU against 2.15e11 EU back: generous, never free
recipes.name: spin_down
